payload.in_their_words: Cool table of stamp fees, but this is for rich Americans with a villa already locked in. Paid concierge, partnered planners, no prices? Nah. I'll just email the venues myself.

findings.quote: Wedded Wonderland Concierge is a paid advisory service that starts with a free, no-obligation Discovery Call.
findings.issue: 'Free' wording can act as a poor-fit lead magnet; nothing near the call says who it is for (budget level, scale).

findings.quote: Ask how the service is paid, and whether it receives anything from the partners it recommends.
US documents, two sworn declarations and three offices in Italy (all explained below)
